system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: We introduce a dynamic complexity cue within the system prompt in order to guide the complexity of artifacts generated by thedraft and improve operators.
system_prompt_style.note: Jinja templates per operator (src/dojo/config_dataclasses/llm/jinjaprompt.py) plus per-node complexity cue and memory injection.

env_context_strategy.note: Task prompt templates for MLE-bench not included in evidence bundle; no tool list since operators are single LLM calls.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Truncate a string to 200 characters and add ellipsis.
context_compaction.note: Memory operator builds hand-defined summaries of past nodes (paper Sec. 2.3 'running summary'); 'summarize' via heuristic memory processor; no_memory option reachable.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The environment captures and returns the status, standard outputs, tracebacks for debugging, and the code block execution time to the agents.
observation_format.note: GPT-4o structured outputs parse execution output for the harness, not a model-facing observation format.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: We use Jupyter notebooks to execute code from the agents. With this interface, agents can execute arbitrary Python code, perform file reads and writes, and even use the shell via Jupyter magic commands.
tool_call_format.note: Operators emit fenced scripts which the harness executes.

tool_count.evidence_quote: Draft (3–5-sentence plan + fenced script that trains, evaluates, and writes submission.csv)
tool_count.note: No function schemas exposed to the model; actions are whole code scripts. Closest fit.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Draft (3–5-sentence plan + fenced script that trains, evaluates, and writes submission.csv); Debug (short diagnosis and repaired script given a traceback)

tool_schema_source.note: No tool schemas; operators are prompt-based. No tool registry in evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: Dependency files and full source not in bundle; cannot grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Search Policy**: The method used to explore the solution space and orchestrate the execution of operators (e.g., greedy search, evolutionary search, Monte Carlo Tree Search)
loop_primitives.note: Default run_example uses AIRA_GREEDY; MCTS and evolutionary reachable via config. Draft/debug/improve is generate-execute-repair.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: **Plan**: The strategy or approach for this solution
planning_granularity.note: Plan text stored per node but not a maintained plan object re-read across steps.

multi_agent_topology.note: Operators are LLM calls orchestrated by a search policy, not separate agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: all operators are LLM-driven except for theMemory operator, which is defined by hand.

human_in_loop.note: Run loop source not in bundle.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The Journal maintains the collection of all solution nodes and provides:

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: In contrast, we focus on addressing each competition independently.

self_verification.evidence_quote: We always use GPT-4o (OpenAI, 2024) with Structured Outputs to parse code execution outputs—extracting run success, summary text, and validation metric.
self_verification.note: Harness executes each script and evaluates fitness (5-fold CV).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Buggy children enter an automaticDebug loop until fixed or the budget expires.

rollback.note: Nodes are independent scripts; no rollback discussion in bundle.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: the termination criterion is set as thewall-clock time or themaximum number of artifacts, whichever happens first
termination_condition.note: max_tokens not evidenced; wall-clock is a timeout (F3).

timeouts.evidence_quote: the agent is allowed a 24-hour wall-clock window. Within this period, each agent has a maximum runtime of 4 hours per code execution.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The environment enforces program-level constraints, such as total runtime limit, GPU and CPU usage, memory, and storage, usingApptainer containers

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: agents possess root-like privileges within their isolated containers, granting them full control over their environment.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Internet access is permitted solely for fetching third-party packages and model checkpoints.
network_policy.note: Policy statement; enforcement mechanism not shown.

permission_model.note: Interpreter permission code not in bundle.

tracing.evidence_quote: The journal entries are initially stored as JSONL (one JSON object per line), then processed into the structured journal.json file
